analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($166.18) vs SMA5/20/50 ($164.20/$163.05/$165.93) — mixed signals with SMA5 above, SMA20 and SMA50 below.
· Significantly below SMA100/200 ($178.83/$214.48) — confirms weak medium to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (10.3%) + near historical lows — potential for recovery but trend reversal unconfirmed.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.7→51.8) + sustained neutral zone — confirms lack of directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1.8469→1.0801) + improving — not a bearish signal, but bullish expansion is weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $163.05) + 11.74% band width — indicates sideways consolidation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($163.13) + confirmed support based on Pivot S1 ($147.82) and SMA20 ($163.05).
· Swing resistance ($173.09) + confirmed resistance based on Pivot R1 ($183.01).
· 5-day/20-day price range pattern — indicates sideways movement.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.68x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + wait for directional confirmation before entering.
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 5일 및 20일 이동평균선이 현재가 주변에서 얽혀 있으며, 뚜렷한 추세 형성보다는 횡보 구간에 머물러 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: On the daily chart, the 5-day and 20-day moving averages are intertwined around the current price, indicating a sideways consolidation rather than a clear trend formation.
keyPoints: RSI가 50선 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재를 나타냄
MACD 히스토그램은 개선 중이나 여전히 약한 수준으로 강세 전환 신호로 보기 어려움
거래량 감소는 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도를 낮추는 요인
keyPointsEn: RSI is consolidating around the 50 level, showing a lack of directional momentum.
MACD histogram is improving but remains weak, not yet a strong bullish signal.
Decreased trading volume reduces the reliability of current price action.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 10.2로 추세 미형성 구간이므로, 향후 급격한 변동성 출현 시 추세 전환으로 단정하기보다 충격성 되돌림 가능성을 염두에 두어야 한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 10.2, indicating a lack of trend, any sharp volatility should be considered a potential shock reversal rather than a trend change.
